summary: Build Pablo's Ladder (30 Planks) and store 90 Sticks in Firewood Yards (about 23 Logs) while keeping everyone warm. Greenhouses with Cabbage already exist for food. Start a Lumberjacks' Base from fallen pine sticks, then a Bonfire, Sawmill and Firewood Yards.

build_order.note: 6 Sticks from fallen sticks; no Sticks or Logs start in stock.
Its build site is already placed; deliver 30 Planks.
4 Logs; 1 Log makes 4 Sticks. Build a second one if one yard will not hold 90.
3 Stone + 3 Planks; heated beds. Nine people share one Basic House at the start.

pitfalls: The Bonfire and cabin stoves burn Sticks from the same yards; the objective counts what is stored, so overproduce.
Ladder planks come after heat and fuel, but don't leave it to the last days.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
